   **Bugs and stability.**
      18 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 22, 2026 - Oct 16, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Lydster1001_, Oct 16, 2026, 1/5: "It has been months since you have updated the UI and yet it still is broken. I have spent months trying to give this app a chance to fix itself. There were zero problems before your big update. Now it’s slow and doesn’t even lock/unlock when its supposed to which is the app’s whole point. I have to continuously check for updates just to use this app, making yet another chores and nullify the whole purpose of your app. I have been extremely disappointed by this app since the big update months ago. I used to recommend this app to everyone I knew. Now I am embarrassed I did that. These bugs are too big to justify using the app any longer. The old UI was more user friendly, easier to understand, more interactive, and actually worked. I used to pay for this app also. Now it’s a waste of money."
            2. _Daisylover123321_, Oct 16, 2026, 1/5: "awful. I used to love Opal, but i finally had to delete it because their new version is just sooo glitchy and impossible to use. it is the least user-friendly interface now, and it doesn't even work. i'm switching to a different app for the same purpose, i just can't take Opal anymore."
            3. _Tomito6_, Oct 2, 2026, 1/5: "I payed this app for almost a year. Not worth it at all! I found a much better app that was not 20€ per month. And let me tell you that this app also often didn’t work. It’s super buggy!! For some reason my instagram always seemed to unlock between 23-24 (even if I put a lot of extra rules or changed stuff) it also often didn’t revognize time limits so it’s quite literally not doing it’s only purpose, while demanding 20€. Hoooorrrribble app. Migrated to a new one and wish I could go back in time to avoid this scam"
